steps.content:
# Spec

## Goals

- A user signs in on the Login page and lands on Home. [[board:main#login]]

## Acceptance criteria

- Signing in with a valid account opens Home.
- A wrong password keeps the user on Login with an error.

steps.text:
Wrote .blueprint/spec.md with Goals and Acceptance criteria.
The goal cites the Login box on the main board.
I will sketch the sign-in flow as two steps.

I proposed a two-node flowchart: Login leads to Home.
Accept it to keep it, or select it and ask me to refine it.

input.description: Push the branch to open its PR

steps.text:
Added src/login.ts and committed it on this branch.
https://github.com/example/blueprint-demo/pull/1
The sign-in check is a stub; the real check is left to the auth service.

tasks.title: Build the Login page
tasks.body: Add a Login page with user and password fields that signs the user in.
acceptance: Signing in with a valid account succeeds.

tasks.body: Add the Home page a signed-in user lands on.
